author: Charles.Yu
name: Guihua Explicit Module
description: Generates an explicit compile-time ASP.NET Core module and its xUnit test project. The module does not scan or rewrite the host.

postActions.description: Add the generated projects and explicit host registration.

manualInstructions.text: Open the generated README.md and run its dotnet sln add, host project reference, and composition-root steps. No host source is modified automatically.
